channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Australia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new prize - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• BigCi Environmental Awards 2026
    https://bigci.org/awards/
    Bilpin International Ground for Creative Initiatives (BigCi) · deadline Closed 02 Aug 2026 · Two awards, each of AUD 5,000 prize money plus four weeks of free residency at BigCi, guided walks in the surrounding national parks and research assistance for the project. AUD 40 entry fee, non-refundable and payable with the submission.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new prize - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• The Richell Prize for Emerging Writers 2026
    https://emergingwritersfestival.org.au/richell-prize-2026/
    Emerging Writers' Festival and Hachette Australia · deadline Closed 13 Jul 2026 · AUD $10,000 prize money (donated by Hachette Australia); 12-month mentorship with a Hachette Australia publisher; first option to consider finished work for publication. Long- and short-listed writers also eligible to apply for a Casa Morphosi Residency in Abruzzo, Italy. No application fee.
